contentList.content: You are so evasive that attackers rarely gain the upper hand. No attack roll has advantage against you while you aren't incapacitated, and critical hits against you count as normal hits.
If your attack misses a target, you can turn the miss into a hit. Recharges on a Short Rest.
Your mastery of ki grants you proficiency in all saving throws. Additionally, whenever you fail a saving throw, you can spend 1 ki point to reroll it.
Spend 4 ki points to become invisible for 10 turns. While invisible, you gain resistance to all damage except Force damage.
Whenever an enemy within melee range is struck by an ally's attack, you can use your reaction to make a melee attack against that creature.
You can use the Hide action as a bonus action on your turn.
You gain preternatural awareness. You cannot be blinded and can detect invisible creatures within 9m.
You add your Wisdom modifier to your attack rolls and weapon damage rolls.
Whenever a creature makes an attack roll against you, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage on the attack roll.
Use an action to end harmful spells and magical conditions affecting yourself or an ally.
You are constantly shielded by holy warding. You cannot be charmed or frightened, and gain the continuous effects of Protection from Evil and Good.
When you are reduced to 0 hit points and are not killed outright, you drop to 1 hit point instead. Recharges on a Long Rest.
You gain resistance to non-magical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.
When a creature under your Vow of Enmity makes an attack, you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against it.
The radius of your protective paladin auras extends outwards to 9m (30ft).
While concentrating on a Conjuration spell, damage cannot break your concentration.
You manifest dragon wings from your draconic heritage, granting you the ability to fly at will and increasing your movement speed.
When you are hit by a melee attack, you can use your reaction to deal 14 Lightning damage to the attacker and push them 6m away.
You can cast Invisibility on yourself at will, without expending a spell slot.
You can cast Disguise Self at will, without expending a spell slot.
Choose a level 1 spell from the list below
Choose a level 2 spell from the list below
You gain an additional use of Action Surge between Short or Long Rests.
When a spell or effect would deal half damage on a successful Dexterity saving throw, it deals no damage if you succeed, and only half damage if you fail.
You gain an additional superiority die (d10), bringing your total to 6 superiority dice. Expended superiority dice are restored on a Short or Long Rest.
Whenever you fail a saving throw, you can use your reaction to reroll it. You can use this feature twice between Long Rests.
Whenever you fail a saving throw, you can use your reaction to reroll it. You can use this feature three times between Long Rests.
You have advantage on saving throws against spells. Furthermore, you have resistance against the damage of spells.
Your strength is legendary. You gain advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws.
When you use Action Surge, you can teleport up to 9m as a bonus action or reaction before or after your extra action.
Channel magical momentum from Action Surge, gaining the ability to teleport up to 9m.
Teleport up to 9m to an unoccupied space you can see.
Charged with martial magic. You can instantly teleport up to 9m.
At the start of each of your turns, if you have less than 50% of your maximum hit points remaining, you regain hit points equal to 5 + your Constitution modifier.
You can establish lethal ki vibrations in a creature's body with an unarmed strike, and later detonate those vibrations to inflict devastating necrotic damage.
Spend 3 ki points to deliver an unarmed strike that inflicts lethal ki vibrations in the target's body for 10 turns.
Detonate the lethal vibrations within affected creatures. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 10d10 Necrotic damage (half damage on a successful save).
Detonate the lethal vibrations within the targeted creature. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 10d10 Necrotic damage (half damage on a successful save).
Lethal ki vibrations course beneath the skin. The monk who struck you can detonate them at will to inflict devastating necrotic damage.
You attain complete harmony with the primordial forces. You gain resistance to Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, and Thunder damage, and your Ki pool expands by 2 points.
You are aware of the location of any hidden or invisible creatures within 10m of you, provided you are able to hear.
You gain the ability to distract targets with your Mage Hand or cunning diversions. You gain advantage on attack rolls against targets within 3m of your Mage Hand or an ally.
Direct your Mage Hand or magical feint to distract an enemy as a bonus action, granting advantage on attacks against them.
Distracted by a spectral hand or magical feint. Attack rolls against this creature have advantage.
You have learned enough about magic to improvise its use. You ignore class, race, and spell restrictions on magical equipment and scrolls, and gain a +2 bonus to all saving throws.
You move with preternatural swiftness. During the first round of combat, you gain an additional Action.
Infused with swift reflexes during the opening moments of battle.
You have become a master of instantaneous death. When you attack and hit a creature that is surprised, your damage dealt against it is doubled.
When you successfully Turn Undead, the undead also takes [1] Radiant damage and its Undead Fortitude is disabled.
When you successfully Turn Undead, the undead also takes [1] Radiant damage and its Undead Fortitude is disabled.
Whenever you roll dice to restore hit points with a spell, you instead use the highest number possible for each die.
You can use a bonus action to manifest elusive illusory duplicates that confound attackers and grant advantage on your attack rolls.
Summon illusory duplicates that distract enemies, granting you Mirror Images and advantage on attack rolls for 10 turns.
Surrounded by illusory duplicates, granting advantage on attack rolls.
You command beasts and vegetation with primal authority. You can use your Channel Divinity to charm beasts and plants as a bonus action.
Channel divine energy to charm beasts and plants within 9m as a Bonus Action.
You can peer into the temporal fabric of the world. You gain expertise in History and Insight, and gain advantage on Perception checks.
Call upon your deity's direct intervention. Unlike mortal appeals, at 20th level your communion recharges once every Long Rest.
Summon a bountiful chest laden with camp supplies and potent potions.
Call down a celestial storm dealing 8d10 Radiant damage to all enemies within 15m.
Resurrect fallen comrades with half hit points and restore allies to full health and spell slots as though they had completed a Long Rest.
Entreat your deity to forge a legendary weapon of the heavens in your hand.
You retain the ability to cast spells while transformed in Wild Shape.
You gain unlimited uses of Wild Shape, allowing you to transform freely.
Beasts and plants hesitate to harm you. Hostile beasts and plant creatures have disadvantage on attack rolls made against you.
As an action, you emanate a 9m aura of bright sunlight for 10 turns. Hostile creatures in the light take 10 Radiant damage each turn, and you gain advantage on saving throws against spells.
Cloaked in bright sunlight. You have advantage on saving throws against spells, and enemies within 9m take 10 Radiant damage each turn.
As an action, you assume the mantle of primeval nature for 10 turns. You regenerate 10 hit points per turn, and you can cast spells as bonus actions.
Infused with primeval vitality. You regenerate 10 hit points at the start of each turn, and can cast spells as bonus actions.
As an action, you manifest luminous wings of vengeance for 10 turns. You gain an 18m fly speed and radiate a 9m terror aura causing enemies to become frightened.
Luminous wings carry you across the battlefield with 18m flight speed, while your presence imposes a 9m terror aura on foes.
Shaken by the dread wrath of the Avenging Angel.

As an action, you surround yourself with an aura of gloom for 10 turns. The 9m aura imposes disadvantage on enemy attack rolls and deals 4d10 psychic damage to frightened creatures at the start of their turn.
Surrounded by an aura of gloom that demoralizes enemies and torments the fearful.
Cloaked in supernatural gloom. You have disadvantage on attack rolls, and take 4d10 Psychic damage at the start of your turn if frightened.
Beneficial spells you cast on yourself also affect your companion beast while within 9m of you.
Your magical bond projects your self-buffs onto your companion beast within 9m.
Choose 2 Spells from any class's spell list to add to your repertoire.
Whenever you use a Blade Flourish option, you can choose to roll a d6 instead of expending one of your Bardic Inspiration dice.
Attack with flourish, dealing an extra 1d6 damage and increasing your Armour Class by 1d6 on a hit without expending Bardic Inspiration.
Attack with flourish, dealing an extra 1d6 damage and pushing your target back 6m without expending Bardic Inspiration.
Attack up to 2 enemies at once, dealing an extra 1d6 damage to each without expending Bardic Inspiration.
Make a ranged attack with flourish, dealing an extra 1d6 damage and increasing your Armour Class by 1d6 on a hit without expending Bardic Inspiration.
Make a ranged attack with flourish, dealing an extra 1d6 damage and pushing your target back 6m without expending Bardic Inspiration.
Make a ranged attack that hits up to 2 enemies at once, dealing an extra 1d6 damage to each without expending Bardic Inspiration.
Your Bardic Inspiration die increases to a d12.

You gain a measure of control over the eddies of chaotic magic. When an enemy casts a spell within 18m, you can use your reaction to twist the weave and force them to suffer a chaotic surge from the Wild Magic Surge table.
Use your reaction to inflict a hostile Wild Magic Surge onto an enemy spellcaster.

Instantly banish a target through the nightmare landscape of the Lower Planes for 1 round. When the target returns at the end of their next turn, they take 10d10 Psychic damage (unless they are a fiend). Recharges on a Long Rest.
Banished through the horrific depths of the Lower Planes. Takes 10d10 Psychic damage upon return.
Infect the mind of an incapacitated, sleeping, or paralyzed humanoid with an alien psionic link, permanently charming them into your thrall until removed. Recharges on a Long Rest.
Mentally dominated by the Great Old One's warlock. Bound to obey their commands.

Plunge a creature into an illusory realm of misty nightmares. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed, frightened, and incapacitated for 3 turns. Ends early if it takes damage. Recharges on a Long Rest.
Trapped in an illusory fey mist. Charmed, frightened, and incapacitated until damage is sustained.
Your prescient visions deepen in power and clarity. You gain an additional Portent die after a Long Rest (3 Portent dice total).
When you cast a damage spell of 1st through 5th level, you can maximize all damage dice instead of rolling. Recharges on a Short or Long Rest.
Maximize the damage dice of this spell.
Overchannel has been expended and will replenish on a Short or Long Rest.
Assert necromantic dominance over an undead creature. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or fall under your mental control. Recharges on a Short or Long Rest.
Bound under the mental thrall of the necromancer.

Channel the prime matrix of your Transmuter's Stone into a touched creature, completely restoring it to maximum hit points and curing all poisons, diseases, curses, and debilitating conditions. Recharges on a Long Rest.
When you cast an Enchantment spell of 1st level or higher that targets only one creature, you can target a second creature as well.
Create an illusory duplicate of yourself as a reaction when attacked, automatically causing the attack to miss. Recharges on a Short or Long Rest.
Interpose an illusory duplicate to cause an incoming attack to miss.
